content.title: THE DAILY CHEAT SHEET FOR A {{CALMER}} BODY AND MIND
facts: **Sunlight** -> 10 min within 1 hour of waking -> Resets your clock
**Humming or singing** -> 5 min/day -> Tones your vagus nerve
**Standing up slowly** -> every time, for 3 sec -> Protects blood pressure
**Eye breaks from screens** -> every 20 min, look 20 ft away -> Prevents eye strain
**Gratitude note** -> 3 lines before bed -> Lowers nighttime anxiety
**Barefoot time on grass** -> 10 min/day -> Reduces inflammation markers
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these are way easier than they sound, and the payoff is bigger than you'd think. Beets are loaded with nitrates that your body converts into nitric oxide, which relaxes and widens blood vessels so your heart doesn't have to work as hard. Dead hangs aren't just for grip strength, they gently traction your spine and decompress the discs that get squeezed all day from sitting, which is why your back can feel instantly looser after just a few seconds. And humming might sound silly, but the vibration directly stimulates your vagus nerve, which is the main switch your body uses to shift out of fight-or-flight and into rest-and-digest mode. Everyone's body responds a little differently, so pay attention to what actually makes you feel better.
